headline: Archidply Decor submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
summary: Archidply Decor Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. The filing completes the mandatory post-AGM compliance requirements for the company. Retail shareholders can review the passed resolutions on the exchange portal. The procedural update has no immediate financial impact on the company's stock.
why_it_matters: No direct financial consequence for retail investors
